events.title: Eyes in the Window Demo Arrives This Month!
events.summary: The wait is almost over.We're excited to announce that the first public demo of Eyes in the Window will be released later this month.This demo is a very short first look at the project. Its goal is to introduce the atmosphere, visual style and direction of the full game, while giving players a taste of what's to come.Explore the first environments, experience the opening moments of the story and discover the unsettling world that awaits.This is only the beginning.
